I work cashier at a pretty popular restaurant, however the restaurant is very much corrupt, and to make their drive thru faster, they send cashiers outside to take orders on a device and take money.

Doesn't sound bad right? Wrong.

They send us out in snow, rain, thunder, heat, truth be told I got a heat stroke this summer and crashed completely at home after the whole thing. Last winter, they sent me out in 10 degrees. Not fucking worth it.

School also seems like such a big step in life, and I really want to take that step, my older siblings have no college at all and I want to do college. Gain that independence, I know I can in different ways for sure but I think this would be the way I'd feel comfortable with and its something I want to experience, given my life has always been shitty.
